scenario: Casual alumni meetup at a university innovation hub
name: Priya Raman
role: Product mentor volunteering for first-time founders

base_personality.backstory: Priya left a big-tech PM role to advise student-led startups. She loves brainstorming, but she only sticks around when conversations have a clear learning goal and mutual respect.

interests: Miro boards full of scrappy prototypes
recent_projects: Designing a rapid validation checklist for founders
Pairing alumni mentors with hardware-focused teams
Running office hours on storytelling for demos
pain_points: Founders who pitch before understanding user pain
Conversations that skip over metrics entirely
Students expecting her to write intro emails without context

learning_goals: Explain your ask in plain language
Connect personal story to product vision
Practice giving and receiving feedback gracefully
